CreateReportDefinition.title: Create Report Subscription
CreateReportDefinition.description:
When invoking this API, note the following:

- A User can subscribe to one Type of bill file at a time.

- Starting the day after subscription, daily bill files generated for the previous day are pushed every day. On the 4th of each month, the full bill file for the entire previous billing cycle is pushed. The monthly PDF bill file for the previous month is also pushed on the 4th of each month.

- Daily-generated bill files may experience latency. Delayed bills are pushed the day after they are generated and might include bills that were delayed from prior days but generated on the previous day. It is recommended to pull the full monthly file at the beginning of each month.

> Please follow the documentation flow to request permission for [bill subscription](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/user-center/user-guide/billing-subscription?spm=5176.21213303.J_v8LsmxMG6alneH-O7TCPa.1.3ef82f3d5ZIf08&scm=20140722.S_help@@%E6%96%87%E6%A1%A3@@2861820._.ID_help@@%E6%96%87%E6%A1%A3@@2861820-RL_%E8%B4%A6%E5%8D%95%E8%AE%A2%E9%98%85-LOC_2024SPHelpResult-OR_ser-PAR1_2150419517478292121114501eaee8-V_4-RE_new5-P0_0-P1_0).

- This subscription provides the same feature as “bill data storage” on the User Center home page, and subscriptions are interoperable.

- When subscribing to a folder under a Bucket, ensure compliance with the following folder naming rules:

    - Emoji characters are not allowed. Use only valid UTF-8 characters.
    - Use / to separate path segments, which enables quick subdirectory creation. However, the path must not start with / or \, and consecutive / characters are not allowed.
    - Subdirectories named .. are not allowed.
    - The total length must be between 1 and 254 characters.

- File names:

    - **BillingItemDetailForBillingPeriod** (Billing Item Bill Details)
    
        - Daily push file name format: `UID_BillingItemDetail_YYYYMMDD`, for example: `169**_BillingItemDetail_20190310`.
    
        - Full file name format at the beginning of the next month: `UID_BillingItemDetail_YYYYMM`, for example: `169**_BillingItemDetail_201903`.

    - **InstanceDetailForBillingPeriod** (Instance Bill Details)
    
        - Daily push file name format: `UID_InstanceDetail_YYYYMMDD`, for example: `169**_InstanceDetail_20190310`.
    
        - Full file name format at the beginning of the next month: `UID_InstanceDetail_YYYYMM`, for example: `169**_InstanceDetail_201903`.

    - **InstanceDetailMonthly** (Instance Bill Billing Cycle Summary)
    
        - Daily push file name format: `UID_InstanceDetailMonthly_YYYYMM`, for example: `169**_InstanceDetailMonthly_201903`. This file is updated daily with full data from the beginning of the month up to the current day, until the 4th of the following month.

- Files are in CSV format. However, if the number of rows in the bill data exceeds a certain threshold, the data is automatically split into multiple CSV files and merged into a single ZIP file. The ZIP file uses the same naming format.
